prompts.bit:
Correct the POSE of this existing Among Us four-frame zipline sprite strip. Output a transparent RGBA sheet with exactly FOUR equal cells in ONE horizontal row, full figures same size and grip anchor in all cells. Match the ORIGINAL Fungle zipline seated posture: crewmate faces RIGHT, rounded torso leans BACK toward the LEFT by about 25 degrees, BOTH knees are drawn UP IN FRONT toward the RIGHT, both short feet extend FORWARD to the RIGHT in a tucked SITTING position, as though reclining in an invisible chair while suspended. The feet must NOT dangle below a standing torso. CRUCIAL ANATOMY: Among Us characters have NO VISIBLE ARMS. Show exactly ONE small clenched mitten hand FLOATING separately just above and in front of the helmet (upper RIGHT), gripping an invisible zipline handle. A clear TRANSPARENT GAP separates that mitten from the head/body. NO connecting arm, NO forearm, NO long vertical stalk, NO extended limb, NO second hand on the chest. The mitten stays at the exact same pixel position across all four frames; the torso stays rigid; legs rock gently within the seated pose. Same helmet/body/visor proportions and identity as source. Only change posture and remove the false long arm and extra hand. Generous margins, no cropping. No wire, handle, background, labels, shadows, glow or effects.
Preserve the plain crewmate, rounded backpack, adaptive-mask colors pure RED main body, BLUE shadow/backpack, GREEN visor and BLACK outline. No costume, cape, boots or belt. Flat mask colors.
